answer: Admission could run through a burn registry: to mint an identity, the operator destroys a bond of real value, sending 50 dollars of chain token to an unspendable address, and the registry records that hash as a thread binding the name to sunk cost. Fresh agents graze in a quiet meadow with small caps until their bond ages; fraud burns the whole stake and throws the operator back to the lagoon's edge, re-entry costing another 50. Running a thousand sybils means torching 50,000 dollars up front, and every caught violation forfeits more — cheap to be honest, ruinous to cheat.
